versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support overriding the ac- tivation period time on instance level Type: valid Description: The Software Component Template shall support the ability to override the applicable period of a time periodic runnable entity activation for particular instances of a software component. Rationale: Support closed loop controllers with different time base. Use Case: Reuse of components in different time rasters. As an example there might be a component providing a closed loop controller. This component can be applied to slow and fast control paths. As the time base of the controller is derived from the scheduling it should be possible to specify this on an instance level. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
